Subject: Request: retro service credit for 2026-11 outage

Hi Jordan,

Hope you’re well — following up on our chat yesterday. BlueAnchor experienced the prolonged 11/14 inference outage that impacted our batch processing window. Your CS team indicated Redwood would apply a goodwill/service credit if we submitted the request within 60 days of the incident. We emailed procurement and attached the damage summary and usage impact.

When we uploaded the credit request PDF (attached) our billing portal showed the related invoice as locked and we couldn’t auto-apply. Procurement asked if Redwood could manually apply the credit to invoice INV-202611-843 or reissue the invoice with the adjustment.

Can you confirm the 60-day grace still applies and advise next steps? We need this reflected before our month-end close.

Thanks,
Emma

Hi Emma — thanks for sending the packet and the clear ask. I confirm our CS notes refer to a 60-day window for submitting goodwill/service credit requests for incident-related downtime; we should honor that.

I’m looping in Marissa (AM) and Grace (Finance) to confirm the mechanics — specifically whether we can manual-apply vs. reissue INV-202611-843, and whether any tax/VAT reclassification is needed for BlueAnchor’s region. If internal ledger timing blocks the auto-apply, please keep procurement included so they see status.

Jordan

Jordan / team / BlueAnchor — thanks for the clear packet. I reviewed the ledger export and the lock timestamp: our billing system auto-locks invoices 30 days after issue for reconciliation cutover; however, per the documented goodwill process, Finance can approve manual adjustments for approved credit requests within 90 days when coordinated via the AM.

Action taken:
- Created credit memo CM-20261210-BA for $18,450 (service credit tied to 11/14 outage).
- Applied credit memo to INV-202611-843; net balance updated and AR adjusted.
- Reissued invoice as INV-20261210-843-R with annotation: "Adjusted per CM-20261210-BA — goodwill service credit for 11/14 outage."
- Produced a tax-impact note: no VAT reclassification required for this US invoice; if BlueAnchor needs EU entity rebilling we’ll open a separate tax ticket.

Attachments: billing-ledger-export-202611.csv (sourced), CM-20261210-BA.pdf (credit memo stub), INV-20261210-843-R.pdf (reissued invoice stub).

Emma / procurement — please confirm you received the reissued invoice in your portal and whether you need a DocuSign or a PO amendment. If you want this flow automated for future incidents, I can work with Marissa and Grace to propose a 60-day exception path that avoids portal locks.

Ben Carter
Manager, Accounts Receivable | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: CM-20261210-BA.pdf, INV-20261210-843-R.pdf
